top_signals.title: The Golden Dome Proposal is Destabilizing and Dangerous
top_signals.summary:
Editor’s Note: This is the second article in a two-part series exploring the Golden Dome for America proposal. Please also read the first, “Golden Dome Is Technologically and Financially Infeasible.”Golden Dome is an ambitious proposal for a comprehensive, layered defense, with ground, sea, and space-based elements. It is supposed to protect the United States, its allies, and deployed forces from attacks by ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, hypersonic boost-glide vehicles, aircraft, and drones launched by any adversary, including peer adversaries. top_signals.title: SOCAR Bets $1.65 Billion on U.S. Shale Gas Boom
top_signals.summary: Azerbaijan’s state oil and gas company SOCAR has struck a deal with Comstock to acquire some of its assets in the Haynesville shale and an infrastructure subsidiary. The price tag of the deal is $1.65 billion. The purchase includes a 20% stake in Comstock’s legacy Haynesville assets, a 15% stake in Western Haynesville, and 15% of Comstock’s majority interest in gas infrastructure subsidiary Pinnacle Gas Services.
